guides.name: accordion
guides.summary: A vertically stacked set of expand/collapse sections — one open at a time by default, with an option to allow several.

guides.name: activity-feed
guides.summary: A card timeline of recent events — avatar, action text, and a relative timestamp per entry.

guides.name: agent-steps
guides.summary: Shows the steps an AI agent is working through — done, running, waiting or failed — with a count in the header and rows that open to show what happened.

guides.name: ai-badge
guides.summary: A small outline pill with the AI sparkle that marks content an AI made or suggested — "AI draft", "Suggested".

guides.name: ai-button
guides.summary: A stock Quill button that runs an AI action, marked with the AI sparkle; the label stays plain ink.

guides.name: ai-feedback
guides.summary: Asks what was wrong after a thumbs-down on an AI answer — one reason to choose from a short list, an optional note, and Send — opening under the answer so what is being judged stays in view.

guides.name: ai-mark
guides.summary: Quill's AI sparkle — the one icon that means AI, drawn in the AI gradient with a one-star cut for 16px and under.

guides.name: ai-message
guides.summary: An AI's reply in a conversation — the AI mark on its avatar, the answer as plain readable text, and Copy, Try again and thumbs under it. Ships with UserMessage for the person's side.

guides.name: ai-notice
guides.summary: One quiet line under an AI composer saying the AI can be wrong, with an optional link the app supplies.

guides.name: ai-popover
guides.summary: An AI suggestion beside the text it is about — what the AI did, the suggested text on a soft AI wash, then Discard, Try again and Replace.

guides.name: ai-thinking
guides.summary: Shows an AI working before its answer — a shimmering "Thinking" with what it is doing — then folds into one quiet "Thought for 8 s" row that opens the reasoning.

guides.name: suggested-prompts
guides.summary: Ready-made things to ask an AI — chips for follow-ups under an answer, cards for starters on an empty page, a list in a narrow panel. Picking one fills the composer; it never sends.

guides.name: model-picker
guides.summary: Lets people choose which AI model answers — a quiet name-and-chevron trigger in the composer that opens a list with Auto first, a line on what each model is good for, and a check on the current one.

guides.name: alert
guides.summary: A single inline status box for a message tied to a specific area of the page. `alerts` is this primitive already assembled into a vertical stack of several.

guides.name: alert-dialog
guides.summary: A modal that forces an explicit response to a destructive or irreversible action — unlike Dialog, it cannot be dismissed by clicking outside.

guides.name: alerts
guides.summary: A vertical stack of informational, success, and destructive alerts with icons.

guides.name: analytics-charts
guides.summary: A dashboard pair — an area chart of audience growth beside a bar chart of weekly sales, each on its own card.

guides.name: announcement-banner
guides.summary: Two dismissible announcement banners — an inline bordered page banner and a full-bleed primary-color variant.

guides.name: approval-card
guides.summary: Asks before an AI agent acts — an inline card that names the action, shows exactly what will happen, lets people edit it in place, and has a main button that says what it does.

guides.name: aspect-ratio
guides.summary: Constrains any child to a fixed width-to-height ratio — a CSS-only box, most often used to reserve space for images, video embeds, and thumbnails.

guides.name: avatar
guides.summary: A round image, initials, or icon representing a person or entity — reserves its shape immediately and swaps in the real photo once it loads.

guides.name: badge
guides.summary: A small, non-interactive label for status, category, or count — not a button or a link on its own.

guides.name: badge-on-card
guides.summary: Default, secondary, and destructive badges shown together on a card surface.

guides.name: breadcrumb
guides.summary: A trail of links showing the current page's position in a hierarchy — the last crumb is always the current, non-link page.

guides.name: button
guides.summary: Buttons trigger actions. The default (primary) variant is the single most important action on a surface.

guides.name: button-group
guides.summary: A structural wrapper that merges adjacent Buttons into one visually connected control — shared borders, no owned selection state.

guides.name: calendar
guides.summary: The date-picker primitive built on react-day-picker — supports single, multiple, and range selection modes. `calendar-page` and `calendar-range` are this primitive already composed into full scheduling and booking patterns.

guides.name: calendar-page
guides.summary: A single-date calendar paired with the selected day's session list, in one studio-schedule card.

guides.name: calendar-range
guides.summary: A stateful two-month range calendar for booking a span of days, with clear and reserve actions.

guides.name: card
guides.summary: A bounded content container with header, body, and footer slots — paper-warm surface with a soft ring instead of a box-shadow border.

guides.name: carousel
guides.summary: A horizontally or vertically scrolling item viewport built on Embla Carousel, with Previous/Next controls and keyboard arrow-key support.

guides.name: chart
guides.summary: A themeable wrapper around Recharts — ChartContainer wires a config object to CSS custom properties per series, plus a matching ChartTooltip and ChartLegend.

guides.name: chat
guides.summary: A one-on-one messaging panel — contact header, message bubbles, and a composer input.

guides.name: ai-home
guides.summary: An AI assistant's start page — a soft AI glow, a greeting, the large composer with Ask/Agent modes, and starter cards.

guides.name: ai-chat
guides.summary: A full AI conversation page — past chats on the left, the thread in a readable column with reasoning, source chips and follow-ups, and the composer with the model picker and AI notice pinned to the bottom.

guides.name: ai-side-panel
guides.summary: An AI assistant docked beside the page — a header with History and Close, a removable chip saying what it is looking at, a short thread, and the small composer, on one soft top-to-bottom AI wash.

guides.name: conversation-history
guides.summary: Past AI chats grouped by when they happened — pinned first, then today, yesterday, the last week and earlier months — with the open chat filled and a menu on each row to rename, pin or delete it.

guides.name: checkbox
guides.summary: A single independent yes/no selection — check it or leave it, with no relation to any other Checkbox.

guides.name: checkout
guides.summary: A two-column checkout — payment method picker and card form beside an order summary sidebar.

guides.name: citations
guides.summary: Shows where an AI answer came from — a small chip after each claim, named for its source, that previews it, and an "N sources" list under the answer.

guides.name: collapsible
guides.summary: A single open/closed disclosure toggle — the lower-level primitive behind Accordion, with no item/trigger/content grouping or built-in styling.

guides.name: combobox
guides.summary: A searchable dropdown — type to filter a list, or multi-select with removable chips.

guides.name: command
guides.summary: A keyboard-first search palette — embed inline for settings search, or wrap in CommandDialog for a ⌘K-style command palette.

guides.name: command-palette
guides.summary: A searchable ⌘K command palette with grouped actions, recent items, and keyboard shortcuts.

guides.name: contact-form
guides.summary: A get-in-touch card — name, email, a topic select, and a message field.

guides.name: context-menu
guides.summary: A menu that appears at the pointer on right-click or long-press — a secondary, discoverable-only-by-trying affordance, not a replacement for a visible trigger.

guides.name: cookie-consent
guides.summary: A cookie consent banner offering accept, reject, and preferences actions.

guides.name: dashboard
guides.summary: An app shell with sidebar navigation, a search header, and KPI stat cards.

guides.name: data-table
guides.summary: A filterable members table with a toolbar, ToneBadge status pills, and a per-row actions menu.

guides.name: dialog
guides.summary: A modal window over the page for focused, non-destructive tasks — forms, details, reversible confirmations.

guides.name: drawer
guides.summary: A bottom- or edge-anchored panel built on Vaul, with drag-to-dismiss — a mobile-first alternative to Dialog's centered modal.

guides.name: dropdown-menu
guides.summary: A click-triggered list of actions anchored to a visible button, with full keyboard navigation and typeahead.

guides.name: empty
guides.summary: An empty-state block for zero-data surfaces — icon, title, description, and a primary action, centered in the available space.

guides.name: empty-state
guides.summary: A dashed-border empty state with an icon, explanatory text, and a primary action.

guides.name: error-404
guides.summary: A full-page 404 error state with go-back and home recovery actions.

guides.name: example-app-page
guides.summary: A whole signed-in app page, composed: the sidebar-nav shell around a page-header, then stat-cards, then a data-table.

guides.name: example-auth-page
guides.summary: A whole sign-in page, composed: login-split-panel alone on the page, with nothing competing with the one task.

guides.name: example-marketing-page
guides.summary: A whole public marketing page, composed: navbar, hero, feature-section, pricing, testimonial and footer, one idea per section.

guides.name: faq
guides.summary: A centered FAQ section — an accordion of common questions with a contact call-to-action footer.

guides.name: feature-section
guides.summary: A marketing section with an editorial heading and a three-column feature grid.

guides.name: field
guides.summary: A form field wrapper that connects a Label, FieldDescription, and FieldError to a control.

guides.name: file-upload
guides.summary: An asset-upload card with a drag-and-drop dropzone and a progress-tracked upload queue.

guides.name: footer
guides.summary: A marketing footer with brand blurb, link columns, and legal links.

guides.name: forgot-password
guides.summary: A password-reset request card — an email field, a send-link action, and a way back to sign in.

guides.name: hero
guides.summary: A centered marketing hero — a release badge, serif headline, supporting copy, and primary/secondary calls to action.

guides.name: hover-card
guides.summary: A glanceable preview that opens after a brief hover-intent delay on a link — a visual enhancement for sighted mouse and keyboard users, informational only.

guides.name: icon
guides.summary: The Quill icon component — Material Symbols Outlined at weight 400, shipped as a self-contained core set of 98 names covering every icon the Quill blocks use.

guides.name: input
guides.summary: A styled native text input for free-form single-line entry — email, name, search, URL.

guides.name: input-group
guides.summary: Merges an input (or textarea) with prefix/suffix addons — icons, buttons, plain text — inside one bordered control.

guides.name: input-otp
guides.summary: Digit-by-digit secure code entry — email verification, 2FA, PIN.

guides.name: invoice
guides.summary: A printable invoice card — sender and recipient details, a ToneBadge payment status, a line-item table with totals, and a download action.

guides.name: item
guides.summary: A general-purpose list row — compose ItemMedia (icon or avatar), ItemContent (title + description), and ItemActions (trailing button) into a consistent row for lists, search results, and settings.

guides.name: kanban
guides.summary: A three-column kanban board with card counts, tagged task cards, and an add-card affordance per column.

guides.name: kbd
guides.summary: A keyboard key badge — a single label rendered as Kbd, or a compound shortcut via KbdGroup — for hotkeys in tooltips, menus, and shortcut references.

guides.name: label
guides.summary: The accessible name for a form control — always associate it via htmlFor/id or co-location.

guides.name: list-detail
guides.summary: An inbox-style split view — a selectable message list beside a detail pane with archive and delete actions.

guides.name: login
guides.summary: The standard email-and-password sign-in card, with remember-me and a forgot-password escape hatch.

guides.name: login-minimal
guides.summary: The bare-minimum sign-in — no card chrome, a single email field, sign-in by one-time code.

guides.name: login-oauth
guides.summary: Provider-first sign-in — Google, GitHub, and Apple buttons above an email fallback.

guides.name: login-split-panel
guides.summary: A full-page, branded sign-in — a testimonial panel beside an email/password form with a magic-link option.

guides.name: mail-shell
guides.summary: A two-pane mail client shell — a searchable message list and a reading pane with toolbar and inline reply.

guides.name: menubar
guides.summary: A desktop application-style menu strip — a row of always-visible top-level menus, each opening its own dropdown on click.

guides.name: native-select
guides.summary: The browser's own `<select>`, restyled to match the theme — the OS-native picker, not a custom-rendered popover.

guides.name: navbar
guides.summary: A top navigation bar with brand wordmark, a responsive link list, and sign-in / get-started actions.

guides.name: navigation-menu
guides.summary: Top-level site navigation with mega-dropdown panels — for public/marketing navigation, not desktop application chrome.

guides.name: newsletter
guides.summary: A centered newsletter-signup section — an email field, subscribe action, and social proof.

guides.name: notifications
guides.summary: A notifications card listing recent events with icons, timestamps, unread indicators, and a mark-all-read action.

guides.name: onboarding
guides.summary: A setup checklist card with a progress bar, completed and pending tasks, and start links for remaining steps.

guides.name: order-summary
guides.summary: A checkout order-summary card — line items, a promo code field, a total, and a pay-now button.

guides.name: otp-verification
guides.summary: A six-digit one-time-passcode entry card for verifying an email, with expiry messaging and a resend action.

guides.name: page-header
guides.summary: A page header with a breadcrumb trail, title and description, and duplicate/new action buttons.

guides.name: pagination
guides.summary: Page navigation for splitting a long list of records into discrete numbered pages, with Previous/Next controls and an ellipsis for skipped ranges.

guides.name: popover
guides.summary: A small, click-triggered overlay anchored to its trigger — for inline forms, filters, and contextual editing, not a blocking task.

guides.name: pricing
guides.summary: A three-tier pricing grid with a highlighted popular plan, feature checklists, and per-plan calls to action.

guides.name: profile-card
guides.summary: A compact, centered profile card — avatar initials, role, follower stats, and follow/message actions.

guides.name: progress
guides.summary: A determinate progress bar for a real, measurable completion value — pass a numeric `value` and pair it with ProgressLabel/ProgressValue for a labeled, live-updating readout.

guides.name: prompt-composer
guides.summary: The box people type to an AI in — grows with the text, sends on Enter, turns Send into Stop while the AI works, with slots for tools, files and a model picker.

guides.name: question-card
guides.summary: An AI agent asks the person to choose — the question, options as full rows with the recommended one first, a free-text row for anything else, and Continue that waits for an answer.

guides.name: radio-group
guides.summary: A set of mutually exclusive options rendered as visible radio buttons — pick exactly one from a short, always-visible list.

guides.name: resizable
guides.summary: Drag-resizable split panels — the user controls how space is divided between two or more regions by dragging a handle between them.

guides.name: scroll-area
guides.summary: A styled custom scrollbar over a fixed-size scrollable region — replaces the browser's native scrollbar chrome without changing scroll behavior.

guides.name: search-results
guides.summary: A docs search panel — query input, result count, and a linked result list with breadcrumbs and type badges.

guides.name: select
guides.summary: A custom-rendered dropdown for choosing one option from a short list — the same look on every platform, unlike the OS-native picker.

guides.name: separator
guides.summary: A thin decorative divider line between stacked or inline content — horizontal by default, vertical for toolbars and inline groups.

guides.name: settings
guides.summary: A profile settings card — name fields, a bio textarea, and an email-notification toggle.

guides.name: sheet
guides.summary: A panel that slides in from a screen edge while the page stays visible behind it — the same Base UI dialog underneath Dialog, styled as an edge panel instead of a centered card.

guides.name: sidebar
guides.summary: The persistent side-rail navigation primitive — expands, collapses to icons, or slides in as an off-canvas sheet on mobile. `sidebar-nav` is this primitive already assembled into a full app shell with grouped menus and a breadcrumb header.

guides.name: sidebar-nav
guides.summary: A collapsible icon-sidebar app shell with grouped menus, badges, a top bar, and a main area for the page — a card grid by default, or the children you pass in.

guides.name: signup
guides.summary: Standard account-creation card — name, email, password, and a link back to sign-in.

guides.name: signup-social
guides.summary: Signup that leads with GitHub and Google provider buttons, falling back to an email/password form.

guides.name: skeleton
guides.summary: An animate-pulse loading placeholder that reserves space and previews the shape of content while it loads.

guides.name: slider
guides.summary: A draggable control for picking a numeric value, or range, within a bounded min/max — position matters as much as the exact figure.

guides.name: sonner
guides.summary: A toast-notification stack for transient feedback about an action just taken — mount one Toaster at the app root, then trigger toasts imperatively with the `toast()` function from `sonner`.

guides.name: spinner
guides.summary: An indeterminate loading indicator — a spinning icon that inherits its color from `currentColor`, for waits with no known duration or percentage.

guides.name: stat-cards
guides.summary: A responsive grid of KPI cards, each showing a value with a delta badge versus last month.

guides.name: stats-band
guides.summary: A marketing band of headline statistics separated by vertical dividers on a card background.

guides.name: switch
guides.summary: An on/off control for a setting that takes effect immediately — no separate Save step.

guides.name: table
guides.summary: A data table for rows of tabular content — headers, cells, an optional footer for totals, and a caption for the accessible description.

guides.name: tabs
guides.summary: A set of triggers that swap which panel is visible in place — content panels share the same position, only one shown at a time.

guides.name: tabs-page
guides.summary: A tabbed settings page with account, notifications, and security panels.

guides.name: team-section
guides.summary: A marketing team grid with avatar cards showing each member's name, role, specialty badge, and email action.

guides.name: testimonial
guides.summary: A customer-quote card with a serif pull-quote, avatar initials, and attribution.

guides.name: textarea
guides.summary: A styled native `<textarea>` for multi-line free text — descriptions, bios, comments.

guides.name: theme-selector
guides.summary: A dropdown picker for the five Quill themes and four pigment accents — sets data-theme/data-accent and persists both to localStorage.

guides.name: toggle
guides.summary: A two-state icon or icon-plus-text button whose pressed state persists after the click — a formatting toggle inside a toolbar.

guides.name: toggle-group
guides.summary: A row, or column, of Toggle buttons sharing selection, sizing, and spacing — single-select for exclusive choices, multi-select for independent ones.

guides.name: tone-badge
guides.summary: Quill's uppercase tag pill for status, tiers, and labels — wraps Badge with the pigment vocabulary (moss/gold/terracotta/indigo/neutral/muted) baked in so tone never drifts per call site.

guides.name: tooltip
guides.summary: A short hint that appears on hover or focus — a supplementary visual label for sighted mouse and keyboard users, not a reliable way to deliver essential information.

guides.name: usage-meter
guides.summary: Shows how much AI credit is left — the number, a bar in the AI gradient, when it renews, what the rest will buy, and a breakdown — with a compact ring for a composer footer.

guides.name: wizard
guides.summary: A multi-step setup card — a progress stepper, workspace fields, and back/continue navigation.
